title: Negation
intro: To make a sentence negative in Russian, simply add не (not) before the word you want to negate - usually the verb. Unlike English, Russian uses double negatives, and they don't cancel out. Saying «Я ничего не знаю» (I don't know nothing) is grammatically correct and means 'I don't know anything.'
rules: Place не directly before the word being negated: Я не знаю. (I don't know.)
Не + verb = negative action: Он не читает. (He doesn't read.)
Не + adjective/noun = negative quality: Дом не большой. (The house is not big.) Это не книга. (This is not a book.)
Double negatives are correct in Russian: Никто не знает. (Nobody knows.) - literally 'Nobody doesn't know.'
examples: Она не говорит по-русски. (She doesn't speak Russian.)
Это не моя книга. (This is not my book.)

items.explanation: Use не before the verb to negate the action: Я не понимаю.

items.prompt: Он _____ работает сегодня. (He is not working today.)
items.explanation: Place не before работает to negate: Он не работает.

items.prompt: Это _____ моя сумка. (This is not my bag.)
items.explanation: Use не before моя to negate possession: Это не моя сумка.

items.prompt: _____ не знает ответ. (Nobody knows the answer.)
items.explanation: Никто (nobody) requires не before the verb: Никто не знает.

items.prompt: Я _____ не видел. (I saw nothing / I didn't see anything.)
items.explanation: Ничего (nothing) + не видел = I didn't see anything. Double negative is correct.

items.prompt: Она _____ не ходит в кино. (She never goes to the cinema.)
items.promptEnglish: She never goes to the cinema.
items.explanation: Никогда (never) + не = She never goes. Double negative required.

blanks: Я _____ говорю по-английски. (I don't speak English.)
Это _____ моя книга. (This is not my book.)
Он _____ работает сегодня. (He doesn't work today.)
У меня _____ машины. (I don't have a car.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Не before verbs/adjectives; нет for 'don't have' (у меня нет + genitive)

minimalPairs.context: Он _____ студент. (He is not a student.)
minimalPairs.explanation: Use не before the noun/adjective to negate. Нет means 'no' as an answer or 'there is no.'

minimalPairs.context: — Ты студент? — _____. (Are you a student? - No.)
minimalPairs.explanation: Нет is used as the answer 'no.' Не is used within sentences to negate.

categorySorting.instruction: Sort into affirmative and negative sentences
